im making a gmae like https://coastalworld.merci-michel.com i want to make it around the startup world

That could work really well. One of the reasons the Coastal World experience is memorable is that it doesn't feel like a menu—it feels like you're exploring a living world where every building has a purpose. It uses a playful 3D environment to tell the story of an ecosystem rather than presenting information directly.

For a startup version, I'd think less about a "city" and more about a startup ecosystem.

🌍 World concept: Startup Island

Instead of banks and fintechs, every area represents a stage of building a company.

                🚀 Launch Pad
                    │
    💡 Idea Lab ─── 🏙 Startup City ─── 💰 VC District
                    │
          👥 Community Square
                    │
          🤖 AI Valley
                    │
          📈 Growth Mountains
                    │
            🦄 Unicorn Castle
Areas
💡 Idea Lab

A garage full of inventions.

Interactive objects:

Whiteboards with startup ideas
Sticky notes you can throw around
Broken prototypes
"Validate your idea" mini-game
🏗 Builder District

Construction cranes are literally building products.

Objects:

Designers drawing wireframes
Developers coding
APIs as glowing pipes connecting buildings
Bugs escaping from computers

Mini game:
Catch bugs before launch.

🚀 Launch Pad

Rocket launches every few minutes.

Companies preparing to launch.

Interactions:

Countdown timer
Press launch button
Product Hunt billboard
Users flooding in after launch
💰 VC District

Glass skyscrapers.

Investors walking around.

Interactions:

Pitch elevator
Term sheet puzzle
Raise funding
Avoid "bad investor" NPCs

Hidden easter eggs:

Giant pile of pitch decks
Coffee everywhere
👥 Founder Park

Relaxed area.

Founders chatting.

Podcast stage.

Meetups.

Campfire conversations.

Click founders to hear:

biggest mistake
best advice
funniest startup story
🤖 AI Valley

Everything is futuristic.

Robots.

GPU data centres.

Agents walking around completing tasks.

Interactive:
Build an AI workflow by connecting tools together.

📈 Growth District

Traffic everywhere.

Marketing billboards.

Analytics dashboards.

Funnels.

Mini games:

Scale servers
Optimise conversion
Reduce CAC
Increase retention
🦄 Unicorn Mountain

Late-game unlock.

Massive headquarters.

Flying unicorn.

IPO bell.

Fun collectibles

Instead of coins:

💰 Funding rounds
⭐ Product Hunt badges
🧠 Startup wisdom
📰 TechCrunch articles
🎟 Conference badges
☕ Coffee cups
🦄 Unicorns
🛠 Open-source tools
NPCs

Characters wandering the world:

Solo founder
Angel investor
VC partner
Indie hacker
Product designer
Staff engineer
AI researcher
Growth marketer
Community manager
Journalist
Customer

Each can have dialogue, quests, or small interactions.

Hidden easter eggs
A garage that becomes a billion-pound company when you revisit it.
A server room overheating until you fix scaling.
A "pivot machine" that transforms one startup into another.
A graveyard of failed startups with humorous epitaphs.
A giant rubber duck floating in a lake labelled "Debugging."
Art style

A low-poly, colourful aesthetic would fit this well:

Bright pastel colours
Soft lighting
Stylised trees and buildings
Tiny animated people
Floating UI elements
Minimal text, with discovery through exploration
A progression loop
Start in Idea Lab.
Build your MVP.
Launch your product.
Find your first customers.
Raise funding (or bootstrap).
Scale your company.
Expand globally.
Reach the Unicorn Mountain.

This gives players a clear journey while letting them wander and discover stories, founders, companies, and startup concepts at their own pace—similar to the exploratory feel of Coastal World, but centred on entrepreneurship rather than fintech.

FILE:
js/ui/HUD.js

Create this file:

export class HUD {


    constructor(){

        this.message = "";

    }



    setMessage(text){

        this.message = text;

    }



    clear(){

        this.message = "";

    }



    draw(ctx, canvas){


        if(!this.message){

            return;

        }



        const width = 420;
        const height = 70;


        const x = 20;
        const y = canvas.height - 100;



        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";


        ctx.fillRect(
            x,
            y,
            width,
            height
        );



        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";


        ctx.font = "20px Arial";


        ctx.fillText(
            this.message,
            x + 20,
            y + 42
        );


    }


}
FILE:
js/engine/Engine.js

Copy the complete version:

import { GameLoop } from "./GameLoop.js";
import { Renderer } from "./Renderer.js";
import { Input } from "./Input.js";
import { Camera } from "./Camera.js";
import { Interaction } from "./Interaction.js";

import { Player } from "../entities/Player.js";
import { World } from "../world/World.js";

import { QuestManager } from "../quests/QuestManager.js";
import { Dialogue } from "../ui/Dialogue.js";
import { HUD } from "../ui/HUD.js";


export class Engine {


    constructor(canvas){


        this.canvas = canvas;



        this.renderer =
        new Renderer(canvas);



        this.input =
        new Input();



        this.camera =
        new Camera();



        this.world =
        new World();



        this.player =
        new Player(
            0,
            0,
            this.input,
            this.world
        );



        this.interaction =
        new Interaction();



        this.questManager =
        new QuestManager();



        this.dialogue =
        new Dialogue();



        this.hud =
        new HUD();



        this.loop =
        new GameLoop(
            this.update.bind(this),
            this.render.bind(this)
        );


    }



    start(){

        this.loop.start();

    }



    update(delta){


        this.player.update(delta);



        this.camera.follow(
            this.player
        );



        this.interaction.update(
            this.player,
            this.world.buildings
        );



        if(
            this.interaction.canInteract()
        ){


            const building =
            this.interaction.getTarget();



            this.hud.setMessage(
                "Press E to enter " + building.name
            );


        }
        else{


            this.hud.clear();


        }



        if(
            this.input.isDown("e") &&
            this.interaction.canInteract()
        ){


            const building =
            this.interaction.getTarget();



            if(building.quest){


                this.questManager.startQuest(
                    building.quest
                );



                const quest =
                this.questManager.getQuest();



                if(quest){


                    this.hud.setMessage(
                        "Quest Started: "
                        + quest.title
                    );


                }


            }


        }


    }




    render(){


        this.renderer.clear();



        const ctx =
        this.renderer.ctx;



        this.world.draw(
            ctx,
            this.camera,
            this.canvas
        );



        this.player.draw(
            ctx,
            this.camera,
            this.canvas
        );



        this.hud.draw(
            ctx,
            this.canvas
        );


    }


}
